pay-online-selected.description: Pay Online selected (border-primary, bg-primary/10): the action button becomes "Pay Online".

paying-online.description: Online payment starting: "Starting payment…", button disabled.

table-order.description: Dine-in table order: Request Bill is offered as a third option (request_bill_enabled is ANDed with a table in the backend, so a pickup kiosk never shows it).

bill-requested.description: Table order, bill already requested: the bill option is disabled and reads "Bill requested — staff notified".

payment-request.description: A payment request without a URL was created: the muted text-xs note appears under the options.

placing.description: Order being placed: "Placing order…", button disabled.

online-only.description: Only customer_payment_enabled: one option, nothing preselected, the action stays "Place Order".

no-payment-options.description: No payment capability: the picker is not rendered and Place Order simply submits the cart.

disabled.reason: not applicable: only the disabled buttons shown as variants

error.reason: not applicable: no distinct error state in this screen

loading.reason: not applicable: no loading state in this screen

empty.reason: not applicable: no empty state in this screen
